claims: The Artemis II mission successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on April 10, 2026, at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission concluded a 10-day trip around the moon.
Full video coverage of the Artemis II reentry and splashdown, including the Orion capsule's parachute deployment, is available on PBS, WBAL-TV, and the NASA YouTube channel.
The Orion capsule landed west of San Diego.
Astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen returned safely.
Videos of the Artemis II reentry and splashdown show the fiery reentry.
Videos of the Artemis II reentry and splashdown show the deployment of parachutes.
Videos of the Artemis II reentry and splashdown show the final splashdown into the Pacific.
A joint NASA and U.S. military team was on-site to retrieve the Orion capsule and crew.
